$comment: Supported Foundry-Edge pairing, metadata version 2. qualification records hosted pairing acceptance separately from actual Foundry publication and verified Edge distribution. Immutable v0.4.0, v0.5.0, v0.5.1 and v0.5.2 release records are under docs/release-notes/. CI reads edge.image; docs/compatibility.md records the unchanged support envelope.

edge.build: published release v0.9.13; verified distribution at 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425. Foundry v0.5.2 was qualified and published with this pairing

requirements: It retains ferrum-edge#5661 conditional writes, ferrum-edge#4611 proxy association, and namespace-qualified resource identity (ferrum-edge 5db1d77a8, aligned in #409). The qualification checks these contracts against the published release.

GET /proxies/{id}/mcp/tools remains a viewer-readable, namespace-scoped MCP catalog read; viewer-key namespace ceilings apply to every namespace route and deny global routes outside the documented allowlist. Capability parity includes the new read route.

Operator reads of upstreams mask the Consul ACL token, and operator reads of plugin configs mask secrets and credential-bearing endpoint URL components, with redaction placeholders. A POST or PUT of an upstream or plugin config that echoes a placeholder at a masked field is refused with 400 before update merging (ferrum-edge#5925), so for upstreams and plugin configs a placeholder is not a round-trip marker; admin-only consumer credential entries still round-trip [REDACTED]. Admin reads are raw and never refused. Foundry's editors block such a save, for a non-admin role and only at the sites Edge masks, until each field is re-entered or cleared.

Ferrum Edge v0.9.13 retains v0.9.11's MCP charset and JSON-RPC batch inspection fixes (ferrum-edge#5954, GHSA-4f9m-cfqg-fhx9, GHSA-f2jp-59r9-fp64), adds native HTTP/3 retained-request admission (ferrum-edge#6009) and partially addresses ferrum-edge#6008 with early route-total bounds. Its publication is not a claim that all upstream security issues are fixed.

v0.9.13 bounds namespace and deployment snapshot authority: conditional backup/restore and deployment-v1 tokens fence stored spec and binary content by SHA-256 and length under new MAC domains, so every tag issued by v0.9.12 or earlier fails closed with 412. GET /deployment-snapshot adds digest-only spec evidence and a required api_spec_contents array with one base64 copy of each stored spec document, so it remains secret-complete; the BFF keeps refusing it for every method and role with 403 FERRUM_BFF_CREDENTIAL_READ_DENIED before capacity admission, JWT signing or upstream fetch. Conditional snapshot paths (GET /backup?conditional=true, conditional POST /restore and both deployment mutations) can return a deterministic 507 NamespaceSnapshotTooLarge without issuing, comparing or applying anything; the BFF relays it unchanged and releases its capacity. Foundry issues no conditional backup, conditional restore or deployment mutation, adds no native deployment profile, recovery journal or capability, and does not consume GET /backend-egress-policy, whose schema_version moves to 2.

Foundry v0.5.2 includes Foundry #544, implementing guarded-write policy #542 (adopted 2026-10-06): guarded replacement and deletion refuse an initial fresh verification read without one nonempty quoted visible-ASCII strong ETag, before any PUT/DELETE. The released v0.5.1 initial unconditional fallback is removed for guarded editor writes; explicit unguarded calls, low-level helpers and plugin membership plans keep their semantics, and the post-412 untagged refusal is unchanged. The v0.9.13 contract check for strong item ETags was included in hosted qualification run 37511649961.

Static guided-schema review at 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425: all five complete component blocks (KeyAuthConfig, RateLimitingConfig, RateLimitingRuleConfig, CorsConfig, PrometheusMetricsConfig) are byte-identical to 0d917701b63ef38210c49df830f48cf0457cbc7d, so every pinned component hash is unchanged. PLUGIN_SCHEMA_SPEC.ref adopts 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425 from hosted run 37509542502, attempt 1, artifact 11434665326 (source 0d6d3c4715edf1bca4ae86ed44f873626cd75ece, tested merge 648d7feadd2d4477229c61016f3a60491281c100): archive SHA-256 19293cf7bb18d8be70b0e1618be1462fff87e2fcdefc8a77735fb5aebf6e672d and export SHA-256 db6cdc1ae8bae2aff6517f33efaef12bcb21f80291bf8107aa56bdca138ddaa0 match the API digest and producer checksum, and all five exported components are unchanged. The sensitivity source is byte-identical to 0d917701 (Git blob 827bf3a7c998c7ea9c995093ab38320facbd072a) and its provenance is now 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425.

The canonical pin adopts published contracts-edge-0.9.13 at 9626821eb089c71f5d4d71268c7b8276a8a5ab50, release 405002564, after successful main Validate contracts run 37507648793. The same 18 scoped files and descriptions are byte-exact. Plugin entries, provisioning values, manifest schema and all 12 fixtures are unchanged; the complete invalid-expectations file versions its deployment-snapshot and backend-egress-policy entries and adds the v2 negatives without adopting those schemas or runtime profiles. Shared manifest/report status remains EXISTING/implemented at Alloy owner 81cbb, with Alloy unpublished.

Foundry v0.5.2 qualified against this published Edge release in hosted run 37511649961, attempt 1; source bc7ca925b68eac86a42bc394bbf9f25e47efffc0 was tested at merge f9703947f384a642b9f7144e6be87e8e68b7a8e5. The release and tag evidence is preserved in docs/release-notes/v0.5.2.compatibility.json.

gateway.admin_security: HS256 admin JWT with audience and FERRUM_ADMIN_REQUIRE_NAMESPACE_CLAIM=true

evidence: Pinned Gateway Contract (capability parity, read-only half)

tested.deployment: deploy/starter: Compose, nginx identity proxy with the shared group-to-role policy, production image

scale.real_gateway: demo seed and contract fixtures: tens of resources per namespace, two namespaces
scale.synthetic_request_budget: 500 and 50,000 records per collection (request counts and bytes only, src/api/dataLoadingBudget.test.ts)

best_effort: database mode on PostgreSQL or MySQL
other Chromium-based browsers, Firefox, and Safari
Kubernetes and other deployments that reproduce the documented trusted-proxy contract
not_qualified: file, dp, mesh, and node_agent gateway modes (modelled read-only in the UI, not run in CI)
any Ferrum Edge release other than v0.9.13 (edge.release) for this release
any Ferrum Edge image other than edge.image for this qualification, including the 0.9.13-ebpf and 0.9.13-ebpf-tools variants
browser latency and more than one concurrent operator at scale

edge_dependencies.what: strong ETag on resource reads and If-Match on PUT/DELETE of proxies, upstreams, consumers, and plugin configs; a malformed If-Match, or one on a route that does not evaluate it, is 400
edge_dependencies.status: first released in Ferrum Edge v0.9.7; retained in Ferrum Edge v0.9.8, v0.9.9, v0.9.10, v0.9.11, v0.9.12, and v0.9.13
edge_dependencies.effect_on_pinned_edge: Foundry's write guard sends If-Match with the ETag of its verification read, so a writer that commits between that read and the write is refused with 412; the gateway contract asserts the 412s and the 400s

edge_dependencies.what: optional proxy_id filter on GET /plugins/config (exact match, paginated over the filtered set, invalid value is 400)
edge_dependencies.status: first released in Ferrum Edge v0.9.7; retained in Ferrum Edge v0.9.8, v0.9.9, v0.9.10, v0.9.11, v0.9.12, and v0.9.13
edge_dependencies.effect_on_pinned_edge: a proxy's Plugins tab lists the proxy-scoped configurations targeting it from the filtered collection instead of the whole namespace; a response the filter did not narrow is refused rather than shown
